Division without NaNs

Source: R/compile_acs_data.R
safe_divide.Rd

A division operation that distinguishes structurally-zero ratios from undefined ones.

Usage

safe_divide(x, y)

Arguments

x

A numeric vector or scalar.

y

A numeric vector or scalar.

Value

A numeric vector. See Details for the behavior at y == 0.

Details

Returns the quotient x / y except in two cases:

  • When both x and y are 0, returns 0 (treating 0 / 0 as a structurally-zero ratio rather than NaN).

  • When y is 0 and x is non-zero (positive or negative), returns NA_real_ (the ratio is undefined).

When x or y is NA, the result is NA.

Examples

safe_divide(1, 2)   # 0.5
#> [1] 0.5
safe_divide(0, 0)   # 0
#> [1] 0
safe_divide(3, 0)   # NA
#> [1] NA
safe_divide(3, NA)  # NA
#> [1] NA
